config.route:
- route:
    from:
      uri: direct:partner-teletalk-ocs
      steps:
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'PAY' && ${header.mwPartnerCode} == 'POSTPAID'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=PAY.postpaid.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/ocs-teletalk/v1/pay&auth=oauth2-cc&secretField=client-secret&clientId=bits-teletalk&tokenUrl=http://mw-simulators:8080/ocs-teletalk/oauth/token"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=PAY.response&definiteStatuses=422"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'PAY'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=PAY.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/ocs-teletalk/v1/recharge&auth=oauth2-cc&secretField=client-secret&clientId=bits-teletalk&tokenUrl=http://mw-simulators:8080/ocs-teletalk/oauth/token"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=PAY.response&definiteStatuses=422"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'INQUIRY'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=INQUIRY.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/ocs-teletalk/v1/bill&auth=oauth2-cc&secretField=client-secret&clientId=bits-teletalk&tokenUrl=http://mw-simulators:8080/ocs-teletalk/oauth/token"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=INQUIRY.response&definiteStatuses=422"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'STATUS_QUERY'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=GET&path=/ocs-teletalk/v1/recharge/{reference}&auth=oauth2-cc&secretField=client-secret&clientId=bits-teletalk&tokenUrl=http://mw-simulators:8080/ocs-teletalk/oauth/token"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=STATUS_QUERY.response&definiteStatuses=200,404"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'REVERSE'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=REVERSE.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/ocs-teletalk/v1/recharge/{reference}/reverse&auth=oauth2-cc&secretField=client-secret&clientId=bits-teletalk&tokenUrl=http://mw-simulators:8080/ocs-teletalk/oauth/token"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=REVERSE.response&definiteStatuses=404,422"
        - to: "kamelet:mw-audit"
